visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair in a ponytail, wearing a white ribbed tank top, is framed in a medium close-up sitting in front of a beige sofa. The background is a tidy living room with soft, warm indoor lighting. She speaks directly to the lens, using active hand gestures and smiling frequently. (2) The shot cuts to a full view of the living room where she stands on a yoga mat on a large rug. She moves through various yoga poses. A ceiling fan rotates above. Then, she is shown sitting on a balcony with several potted plants, overlooking an urban cityscape in daylight. (3) Returning to the indoor close-up, a group photo of her and three others in yoga attire is displayed as an overlay. She continues speaking, using her hands to point and emphasize. (4) The woman is joined by a young man in a white gym shirt; they sit cross-legged on a mat, performing synchronized breathing exercises with arms raised. Graphics with arrows and text appear around them. (5) A sequence of informational graphic slides is shown, featuring diagrams of yoga positions like the downward dog, numbered lists, and illustrations of human chakras. (6) The final phase shows the woman back in her original talking-head position, smiling and joining her hands in a prayer gesture. A text box with a discount code appears at the bottom.
